raw_segments.text: Imogen, I am sprighted with a fool, frightened and angered worse.
Go bid my woman search for a jewel that too casually hath left mine arm.
It was thy masters, shrew me, if I would lose it for a revenue of any kings in Europe.
I do think I sought this morning, confident I am last night, trois on mine arm, I kissed
I hope it be not gone to tell my lord that I kiss aught but he.
